note_for_reviewer: What is whose: shot 1 is the organisation's original emblem (emblem/reference/original.png), captioned as the original, not funkbox's work. Shot 2 is a hand-made redraw (extra letter ל, longer Hebrew line) made outside funkbox (emblem/reference/A-faithful.png), captioned as the target; it is the picture poster_compare scores everything against. Shots 3-5 are three early funkbox poster drafts, shown in the order try 3, try 2, try 1 (shapes + typed Hebrew, kept as emblem/drafts/wrong-1..3.png); their scores are poster_compare against the redraw, written out in emblem/compare/compare-wrong-*.compare.json (41.9, 40.2, 41.1; shown rounded down). The artwork in the later shots is image_trace's vector trace of the redraw (and of the two mashup pictures in refs/hebrew-emblem-v2/) with the lettering lifted out (emblem/trace/). Every word on the emblems is a funkbox text layer from emblem/emblem.copy.json; emblem/renders/*.text_audit.json shows them exact. The 97/100 is compare-a.compare.json (97.6, rounded down). The English is set in Barlow Condensed italic inside its bars (two separate layers, one per bar). The emblem redraws an existing organisation's emblem; the two IDF-insignia mashups (shots mash-b, mash-c) are covered by owner_approval.json, which approves that content only.
